title: MCP Error Payload
description: FROZEN structured error payload (12-error-taxonomy.md §2). Every error the system surfaces — as isError text, in DryRunResult.errors[], or in Diff.design_system.modified_labels — serializes to this shape. TS type name: McpErrorPayload (WP-F05); PHP: ErrorPayload. Aligns with diff.schema.json#/$defs/ValidationError (code/message/element_id/style_id/prop/retryable). The `code` is one of the frozen 29 taxonomy codes (12-error-taxonomy.md §6).

ErrorCode.description: One of the frozen 29 SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE taxonomy codes (12-error-taxonomy.md §6).

ErrorSurface.description: Where the error lands on the MCP wire (12-error-taxonomy.md §1).

message.description: Human, actionable. Includes appended parser errors verbatim where applicable.

http_status.description: The REST status the plugin returned (informational; from the §3 tables by default).

retryable.description: True => an identical / backoff retry MAY succeed (transient).

rpc_code.description: JSON-RPC error code; non-null ONLY when surface=='protocol' (e.g. -32602), else null.

meta.description: Code-specific structured context (12-error-taxonomy.md §3 documents the keys per code). Open object.
